executive_summary: Oroxylin A exhibits highly favorable structural and spatial complementarity against the MexB Efflux Pump ligand-binding domain, leading to efficient efflux pump inhibition and subsequent antibiotic resensitization.
next_validation_steps: Perform micro-dilution biofilm assays against P. aeruginosa strain to evaluate antibiotic resensitization kinetics.
Evaluate competitive displacement of standard autoinducer ligands from the MexB Efflux Pump pocket using fluorescent assays.
Verify non-specific cytotoxicity limits against mammalian cell lines.
